note: TWO OPTIMISATION LEVERS PRICED WITHOUT FLYING ANYTHING. Both count WORK rather than time, which is the only kind of number this device can still answer: under a vsync lock `dtMean` is a MISS RATE and a GPU lever below the floor is invisible by construction (201 handoff 3.1b/3.2). Neither figure is a timing.

residencyCensus.what: What the shipped StreamingDriver ASKS FOR per pose — ring policy against view policy — over a fake engine and worker on a synthetic grid.
residencyCensus.howRun: npx tsx scripts/debug/residency-census.ts (desk; no pak, no GPU, no device)
residencyCensus.reproduced: Re-run on the desk today and it returned all six poses IDENTICAL to the 2026-09-06 desk-censuses row. The census is deterministic, so those numbers are not a one-off.
residencyCensus.theLever: The ring policy asks for 276 cells at EVERY pose. The view policy asks 16-202 depending on where the camera is.
residencyCensus.biggestAtBlockZoom: block · plan is 16 against 276 — keptShare 0.058, ~17x. block · tilted is 26 against 276 (0.094). Block zoom is where a dispatcher actually works.
residencyCensus.smallestAtCityZoom: city · tilted converges at 0.732 — the policy only pays where the camera is close.
residencyCensus.THE_CATCH: The view policy is NOT strictly cheaper. It asks for MORE HD near the camera: 16 HD against the ring's 12 at block · plan, and 14 against 12 at block · tilted. It redistributes rather than only removing, so the saving is in the total set and the HD request grows.
residencyCensus.status: Whether to take it is a DEVICE question and a decision for the user. That it exists is measured.

textureBudget.what: What a pak costs the GPU (the decoded pyramid via the runtime's own ostexLayerBytes) against what it costs on disk, priced in every format.
textureBudget.crossChecksAgainstTheField: The model says 25.4 MB; the 2026-08-12 ASTC field capture measured the texture category at 25.81 MB. Agreement to 0.4 MB, so this calculation can be used to decide without flying.
textureBudget.verdict: ON THIS DISTRICT, TEXTURES ARE NOT THE CONSTRAINT. 25.4 MB against a 300-500 MB residency ceiling, inside a total measured residency of ~76 MB. The ASTC 8x8 lever (halving to 12.0 MB) buys headroom nobody is short of, and pays for it in quality.
textureBudget.whatItDoesNotAnswer: The pak is EIGHT cells. The script's own note says the GPU figure is every array resident at once — the ceiling a FULL-MAP decision is made on — and a whole-map pak is what would test it. Nothing here scales the 25.4 MB to the full map; that needs the pak, not arithmetic.
